data.summary: Pricing draft for headset-stand (synthetic demo product) under demo-direct rule as of 2026-10-24. Tested target revenue margins of 20%, 30%, and 40% with a 10% discount for each target. Undiscounted and discounted prices were calculated; discounted prices do not retain the requested revenue margin in any case.
assumptions: Product costs are synthetic demonstration data from demo-costs-v1 and are not confirmed business data.
Channel rule demo-direct is synthetic demonstration data from demo-rule-v1; it applies a 10% revenue charge rate, 0% tax, 0% advertising, and BRL 2 fixed fee.
Margins are revenue margins, not markup on production cost.
Discount is applied to the recommended selling price; the tool’s discounted case shows the post-discount charged price and resulting margin.
Contribution is not net profit; overhead not modeled in the tool remains excluded.
Failure provision assumes full-print retry behavior as reflected in the deterministic table.
limitations: Unmodeled overhead remains outside the calculation.
Full-print retry assumption is embedded in the failure provision and may differ from actual operations.
No marketplace verification is available for this synthetic channel rule.
Synthetic product and rule are demonstration-only and should not be treated as current business records.

calls.arguments: {"verdict":"revise","findings":[{"evidencePointer":"/summary","issue":"The summary says discounted prices were calculated, but it does not explicitly state the requested comparison set of 20%, 30%, and 40% revenue margins alongside a 10% discount for all targets in a compact result-oriented way.","requestedChange":"Add an explicit summary statement confirming that all three target margins (20%, 30%, 40%) were evaluated with both undiscounted and 10%-discounted results."},{"evidencePointer":"/scenarios/1/scenario/discountRate","issue":"The discounted 20% target scenario is present, but the draft does not label which scenario corresponds to the discounted case in the main narrative, making coverage harder to verify quickly.","requestedChange":"Add per-scenario labels or a short index in the summary or scenario headings that clearly pairs each target margin with its discounted and undiscounted case."},{"evidencePointer":"/scenarios/0/scenario/revenueMargin","issue":"The draft reports revenue margin and markup on production cost, but there is no explicit explanation that markup is distinct from revenue margin in the scenario outputs themselves; this can be misread as interchangeable.","requestedChange":"Add an inline note near the scenario outputs or in assumptions clarifying that revenueMargin is not markupOnProductionCost and that both are intentionally reported as separate metrics."}]}

findings.issue: The summary says discounted prices were calculated, but it does not explicitly state the requested comparison set of 20%, 30%, and 40% revenue margins alongside a 10% discount for all targets in a compact result-oriented way.
findings.requestedChange: Add an explicit summary statement confirming that all three target margins (20%, 30%, 40%) were evaluated with both undiscounted and 10%-discounted results.

findings.issue: The discounted 20% target scenario is present, but the draft does not label which scenario corresponds to the discounted case in the main narrative, making coverage harder to verify quickly.
findings.requestedChange: Add per-scenario labels or a short index in the summary or scenario headings that clearly pairs each target margin with its discounted and undiscounted case.

findings.issue: The draft reports revenue margin and markup on production cost, but there is no explicit explanation that markup is distinct from revenue margin in the scenario outputs themselves; this can be misread as interchangeable.
findings.requestedChange: Add an inline note near the scenario outputs or in assumptions clarifying that revenueMargin is not markupOnProductionCost and that both are intentionally reported as separate metrics.
